Land at PEK.notes: Land 05:00 · HU492 from Brussels. Allow ~1h30 for immigration + bags.

Drop bags at Regent Beijing.hours: Check-in after 15:00; check-out before 12:00; 24-hour front desk.
Drop bags at Regent Beijing.notes: Booked at No. 99 Jinbao Street, beside Dengshikou metro and a short walk from Wangfujing; drop luggage after the 05:00 arrival.

Breakfast.notes: Hotel breakfast; open the hotel card for details.

Temple of Heaven.notes: Enter via the quieter North Gate; joint ticket ¥35, 2–2.5 h.

Lunch.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Beijing city model.hours: 09:00–17:00; last entry 16:00; closed Monday (reconfirm for Aug 2026)

Dinner.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Qianmen & hutongs.notes: Evening stroll down Qianmen pedestrian street and the Dashilan hutongs.

Shichahai lakes.notes: Willow-lined lakes at dusk — bar lights and locals swimming. Early night.

Tiananmen Square.notes: Enter ~07:30; book its separate free reservation with the Forbidden City.

Forbidden City.notes: From opening 08:30 via the Meridian Gate.

Jingshan Park.notes: Climb 15 min for the classic panorama over the Forbidden City's golden roofs.

National Museum.hours: To 17:30 in summer, last entry 16:30, closed Mondays
National Museum.notes: Air-conditioned; the Ancient China galleries alone are 2–3 h.

Wangfujing.notes: Snack street and bookstores — atmosphere over cuisine.

Mutianyu Great Wall.hours: Site + cable car from 07:30 in season

Toboggan down.notes: Wheeled luge down from the wall (¥100 one-way).

Sanlitun Taikoo Li.notes: Dinner plus flagship-store architecture and people-watching.

CCTV 'Big Pants'.notes: Night walk in the CBD — the CCTV HQ and CITIC Tower lit up. Outside-only icon.

Mutianyu night tour.notes: Optional swap: Mutianyu's illuminated evening wall visit (25 Jun–31 Aug).

Summer Palace.notes: At opening (gates 06:00). North Palace Gate → Longevity Hill → ferry across.

798 Art District.notes: Bauhaus factory turned art quarter — galleries, design shops, sculpture.

UCCA.notes: The anchor gallery inside 798 — contemporary art plus the UCCA Store.

Fly from PKX.notes: JD5063 departs 09:40 — be here by 07:40. PKX is ~46 km south of the centre.
